category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response builds the full gauntlet argument, emphasizing week-in, week-out attrition and the superior quality of SEC losses compared to other conferences' wins, without conceding any points.
quote: A 9–3 record in the SEC usually means you were a top-15ish team nationally with a murderous schedule. A 12–1 record in most other conferences usually means you were a top-10 to top-20 team with several games against teams that would be SEC doormats.
